name: bewear
flavor: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

abilities.name: fluffy
abilities.effect: Damage from contact moves is halved.  Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

abilities.name: klutz
abilities.effect: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.

abilities.name: unnerve
abilities.effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
